scope: Episode-only replacement of repeated fire-video clips. Shared art guidelines do not prescribe these locations.

params.prompt:
Create one complete new vertical painted scene of Sol beside an outdoor campfire after dark.

A small campsite on an open ridge at blue hour, with a low stone-ring campfire, a simple muted-ochre canvas tent in the far upper-right, packed mauve-gray earth and broad distant blue hills. An open slate-blue evening sky replaces the enclosed woodland or indoor walls. Cool ambient evening light and gentle local amber firelight; no stars, flying embers or decorative particles.

Medium-wide full-body shot at Sol face height, slightly downward. Sol stands on SCREEN-RIGHT at x=66%, height38%, feet y=76%; a low campfire occupies SCREEN-LEFT at x=28%, y=64%, with a clear gap from Sol. The small tent is distant, at x=77%, y=38%; hills and open sky form broad simple layers. Fixed camera. Quiet lower fifth for editable captions.

Sol stands on solid packed earth beside the campfire, both tiny feet supported and both short rounded arms lowered at his flanks. His compact body is angled shallowly toward the fire on screen-left, with both original dark oval eyes visible. A small contained flame burns on three charred pieces of wood inside a low ring of stones; no people are present.

Preserve the original mascot as a whole: broad compact flame silhouette, asymmetric tip, rounded side lobes, substantial red outer layer, original orange layer and broad cream inner flame with a lobed crown and rounded lower face. Two small close-spaced low-set tall oval eyes are opaque navy #1C2447 with no highlights, whites, gray rims or extra pupils. Short rounded arms and tiny stubby feet keep their original lengths and attachment points. Completely mouthless and blank below the eye pair. No nose, fingers, long legs, neck or separate torso. Keep the face and all filled flame layers coherent. Sol emits no sparks, particles, droplets or detached flame pieces.

Soft matte gouache brushwork, visible layered painted color, subtle paper texture and broad readable shapes across Sol, tent, fire, rocks, earth and sky. Coherent perspective, gentle shading and contact shadows. Keep the cream face readable in the low light. Define forms through light and color without ink outlines, gloss, plastic surfaces, heavy grain or photographic fire.

No text, captions, watermark, indoor fireplace, walls or dense woodland.

Reference roles: image1 controls the original mascot design; image2 shows the original short rounded arms only, without microphone or cable; image3 supplies gouache finish only, without its spring scene, props or multiple characters. Show exactly one Sol in this new evening campsite.

new_requests.authorization: Redo repeated scene clips in this video by returning to image generation and making different scenes.
